name: Hotel Austria
beschreibung: The Hotel Austria welcomes guests to a sunny, peaceful setting in Niederau, located at the entrance to the picturesque high valley of Wildschönau in the Kitzbühel Alps. Comfortably furnished in traditional Tyrolean woodwork, the guest rooms and holiday flats feature contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies presenting wide views of the Markbachjoch and surrounding alpine pastures. For rejuvenating relaxation after hikes or ski days, the on-site wellness area with Finnish sauna and quiet room invites guests to unwind. In the morning, a nutritious breakfast buffet loaded with local Wildschönau delicacies is served. The lower cable car terminal of the Markbachjochbahn and cross-country ski tracks are just a short walk away. In winter, the complimentary ski bus links directly to the Schatzbergbahn and the expansive Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau. Summer delivers family walking trails and paragliding.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine hotel in Niederau in the Wildschönau with sauna amenities, panoramic balconies, and near the Markbachjochbahn.
